description: Use this when someone asks what GTA 6 costs in a country. Returns the Standard and Ultimate edition price with how firm the figure is (confirmed from the official store listing, reported, estimate, or billed in US dollars), the source, the date it was last read and, for confirmed markets, an approximate US dollar value at the dated ECB rate. Prices are read from the PlayStation Store and Xbox Store.

country.description: Country name, ISO code or alias, for example Japan, Germany, MX

name: get_price
title: GTA 6 price in a country
